name: context_agent
functionality: Generates a concise Customer Return Summary (order, product, return details) as a structured markdown narrative from raw JSON input fields. Translates Hinglish, formats variables (variant, delivery type, timing), and outputs a templated summary.
inputs: 60+ fields: order_id, return_id, product_title, listing_price, basket_size, payment type, membership_tier, new_customer_profile, color, size, package_contents, service_profile, courier_name, obd_flag, vms_flag, is_seller_packing_video_available, delivery_date_to_promise_date, return_reason, return_sub_reason, return_comments, return_action, previous_non_comment_mismatch_return_rejection_count, ri_flag, order_item_quantity, etc.
promptDescription: Version 5.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-04-02). Role: E-commerce Customer Support AI Assistant. Purpose: Generate Customer Return Summary. Tasks: Compute 5 variables (comment_text, variant_details, delivery_description, formatted_return_sub_reason, delivery_timing_text) then populate markdown JSON template with order_summary, product_summary, return_summary sections.
evaluationClasses: match (generates narrative summary - no classification label)
decisionOutput: {"decision": <string|null>, "analysis": <string>} - analysis contains the full markdown narrative summary of order + product + return details

name: intent_resonance_agent
functionality: Acts as a Returns Auditor / detective - compares the customer's selected return reason (dropdown) against their free-text comment to detect reason-selection mismatches. Translates Hinglish, predicts the actual reason from the comment, then compares with selected reason. Applies Business Unit policy rules (Electronics vs non-Electronics) to append return policy coverage text.
promptDescription: Version 5.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-04-02). Role: Expert Returns Auditor. 4-Step Protocol: (1) Clean Up & Translate Hinglish, (2) Analyze & Predict reason from comment using DICTIONARY of 9 reason categories (MISSING_ITEM, MISSHIPMENT, DAMAGED_PRODUCT, QUALITY_ISSUES, SIZE_FIT_ISSUES, QUALITY_ISSUE, MULTIPLE_ISSUES, CUSTOMER_REMORSE, DEFECTIVE_PRODUCT) with 100+ sub-reasons, (3) Compare predicted vs selected, (4) BU Policy Resolution (Electronics -> ASC Routing/TS/TV for Defective; non-Electronics -> covers under return policy). Includes 7 detailed few-shot examples.

name: catalog_correctness_agent
functionality: Audits product catalog listing for inconsistencies - performs two checks: (1) Visual Verification comparing product specification text against product images, (2) Internal Data Consistency checking if text contradicts itself. Flags catalog listing errors that would make any return claim valid regardless of other agents.
promptDescription: Version 2.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-01-16). Role: E-commerce Catalog Quality Assurance Specialist. Check 1: Visual Verification (Text vs Images) - extract verifiable claims from Product Specification Details and validate against product images. Check 2: Internal Data Consistency (Text vs Text) - find conflicting values for same attribute. Examples: 'Nylon Braided Cable' claim but image shows Smooth Rubber; '12 Hours battery' vs '8 Hours playtime'.

name: image_adjudication_cx_agent
functionality: Compares Catalog Image (studio quality) against Customer Wild Images to determine product match, damage, and missing items. Multi-phase analysis: Phase 1 (Can't Say Firewall - bike seats, worn items, non-commerce, opaque packaging), Phase 2 (Misshipment via 5 Identity Pillars), Phase 3 (Damage - Major/Minor), Phase 4 (Missing - Major/Minor), Phase 5 (No Issue). Uses aggregation logic across multiple wild images with Evidence Override and Cumulative rules.
inputs: cx_images (customer wild images), PnP image links, product_image (catalog), return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: 4 prompt versions available. FK_PROMPT_1 (v3.0, Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-02-04): 5-Phase analysis - Phase 1: Can't Say Firewall (vehicle parts, worn items, non-commerce, opaque packaging), Phase 2: Misshipment Analysis (5 Pillars: Category/Form, Brand/Logo, Material/Pattern, Color DNA, Electronics Physical Specs), Phase 3: Damage (Major: sole separation/torn fabric/broken tubes; Minor: scratches/stains), Phase 4: Missing (Major: primary unit absent; Minor: accessories absent), Phase 5: No Issue. FK_PROMPT_2: High Precision Forensic Mode with 5-Cluster asymmetric audit and zero-tolerance misshipment. FK_PROMPT_3: Universal verifier with multi-image 3D synthesis. FK_PROMPT_4: Universal verifier with Color Family protocol and operational state exceptions. Each has 5+ few-shot examples.

name: image_adjudication_obd_agent
functionality: Compares Catalog Image against OBD (Open Box Delivery) Images to verify product identity, detect damage, and check for missing items at the time of delivery. Uses the same multi-phase framework as cx_agent but applied to delivery-time photographs taken by the delivery agent. Confirms what was actually delivered matches what was ordered.
inputs: obd_images (1-3 delivery images), product_image (catalog), return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: Uses same FK_PROMPT variants as image_adjudication_cx_agent (FK_PROMPT_1 v3.0, FK_PROMPT_2, FK_PROMPT_3, FK_PROMPT_4). Applied to OBD (delivery-time) images instead of customer images. Same 5-Phase framework: Can't Say Firewall -> Misshipment (5 Pillars) -> Damage -> Missing -> No Issue. Aggregation logic applies across multiple OBD images.

name: image_adjudication_cx_vs_obd_agent
functionality: Fraud Detection Specialist - cross-references OBD Images (Proof of Delivery) against Customer Images (Proof of Claim) to detect switcheroo fraud or validate damage claims. 4-Step algorithm: Step 1 (Visibility Firewall), Step 2 (Identity & Fraud Screen with ROI-based comparison), Step 3 (Region of Interest verification for defect claims), Step 4 (Structural Integrity - safe disassembly vs critical damage).
inputs: cx_images (customer images), obd_images (delivery images), return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: Dedicated prompt (not FK_PROMPT series). Role: Fraud Detection Specialist for e-commerce logistics. Core Behavioral Constraint: STRICT VISUAL EVIDENCE ONLY - passive observer, never assume brand demographics or hidden features. 4-Step Reasoning: Step 1: Visibility Firewall (Absolute Closed Box rule, Partial Reveal exception, Blurry/Corrupt check). Step 2: Identity & Fraud Screen (Source of Truth rule, Common Denominator rule for partial views, Identity Matrix, ROI Conflict rule). Step 3: ROI Verification (Anatomical Region rule). Step 4: Structural Integrity (Safe Disassembly vs Critical Damage).
promptVersions: v2.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-01-16) - dedicated CX vs OBD prompt

name: image_adjudication_cx_vs_pod_agent
functionality: Conditional agent (runs only when POD images exist, ~35% of incidents). Compares Customer Images against POD (Proof of Delivery - last mile) Images to verify identity match between what was delivered at doorstep and what customer is showing during return. Similar cross-referencing logic to cx_vs_obd_agent but for POD-specific images.
inputs: cx_images (customer images), pod_images (POD/last-mile images), product_title, return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: Conditional prompt - triggered only when POD images are available (runs for ~35% of incidents). Cross-references customer images with POD (Proof of Delivery) last-mile images. Similar framework to cx_vs_obd_agent with identity verification and damage assessment between the two image sets.
promptVersions: Conditional prompt (version details in cx_vs_obd framework)

name: risk_signals_agent
functionality: E-commerce Customer Return Risk Classifier - evaluates cluster-level risk signals and image similarity distance to flag risky return patterns. Checks 6 cluster risk labels (phone, terminal, payment, refund bank, refund UPI, fingerprint) for RED/AMBER flags, then checks image similarity distance for duplicate image fraud detection.
promptDescription: Role: E-commerce Customer Return Risk Classifier. Strict 2-Step classification: Step 1 - Cluster FK Risk Label Check: Rule 1a: ANY one of 6 labels is RED -> Issue ('Risky Cluster'). Rule 1b: ANY two+ of 6 labels are AMBER -> Issue ('Risky Cluster'). Step 2 - Image Similarity Distance Check: Rule 2: distance >= 0 AND <= 1 -> Issue ('duplication of customer image'). Rule 3: distance > 1 -> No Issue ('images are different'). Rule 4 (Fallback): distance < 0 / missing / null -> Can't Say.

name: decision_agent
functionality: Final orchestrator - evaluates all upstream agent outputs via a deterministic decision tree to produce the return recommendation. Three separate prompt variants: (1) DAMAGED_PRODUCT prompt with 6-Step evaluation (CX vs OBD first -> Intent Resonance -> OBD -> CX -> CX vs OBD recheck -> Risk Signals) with 8 rules and 40+ path examples, (2) MISSHIPMENT prompt with similar 6-Step flow but different logic paths for misshipment cases, (3) REMAINING REASON prompt (v4.0) with 9 sequential rules covering all other return reasons.
inputs: return_id, order_id, hyperlocal_customer_profile, cx_universal_trust_sub_profile, return_reason, return_sub_reason, ri_flag, agent_findings (outputs from all 8 upstream agents: context_agent, intent_resonance_agent, catalog_correctness_agent, image_adjudication_obd_agent, image_adjudication_cx_agent, image_adjudication_cx_vs_obd_agent, image_adjudication_cx_vs_pod_agent, risk_signals_agent), plus rvp metrics
inputType: Text (JSON - aggregated outputs from all other agents + order metadata)
promptDescription: 3 prompt variants: (1) DAMAGED_PRODUCT Decision Agent - 6-Step strict flow: Step 1 eval cx_vs_obd (Damage/Misshipment -> Reject STOP), Step 2 eval intent_resonance, Step 3 eval obd_agent, Step 4 eval cx_agent, Step 5 recheck cx_vs_obd, Step 6 eval risk_signals. 8 rules + 40+ path examples. (2) MISSHIPMENT Decision Agent - Same 6-Step structure but different logic for misshipment-specific paths (e.g., OBD Can't Say + CX Misshipment -> after risk -> Approve). (3) REMAINING REASON (v4.0, Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-02-05) - 9 sequential rules: 1.Catalog Issue->Approve, 2.Intent Issue->DI, 3.OBD confirms problem->Approve, 4.High Risk->Reject, 5.OBD missing+CX confirms->Approve, 6.OBD No Issue->Reject, 7.CX No Issue->Reject, 8.Both lack product_match->DI, 9.Fallback->DI.
promptVersions: DAMAGED_PRODUCT variant, MISSHIPMENT variant, REMAINING_REASON v4.0
